excerpt.zh: 这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
excerpt.en: Once the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

triggers.en: When a fleet enters a system

texts.zh: 这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
texts.en: Once the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

sections.zh:
自汗国存在以来，我们部族便一直在此。我们见证了辉煌的胜利、伟大的战役，以及可汗们的兴衰沉浮。

因此，当选举新可汗的时刻到来时，我们挺身而出，要求继承我们曾协助铸就的王位。这本该是属于我们的时刻，然而，我们却遭到了背叛。

我们最亲密的盟友煽动其他部落与我们为敌。我们的长者们被屠杀。我们为之浴血奋斗的梦想被窃取。

即便是现在，那些篡位者依然派出身手矫健的杀手追捕我们，仿佛我们的存在本身就玷污了他们窃取的统治名分。我们只是昔日辉煌血统的残余，被追捕，四处流散。

当我们归来时，复仇将会从怒火之中淬炼而出。
sections.en:
For as long as there has been a Khanate, our clan has been there. We were there for the triumphs, the great battles, the rise and fall of Khans.

So when the time came to name a new Khan, we stepped forward to claim the throne we helped to forge. This was to be our moment; instead, we were betrayed.

Our closest allies turned the other clans against us. Our elders were slain. The dream we bled for was stolen.

Even now, the usurpers dispatch their enforcers to hunt us down, as if our very existence offends their stolen rule. We are but remnants of a proud lineage, hunted and scattered.

When we return, our vengeance will be tempered in the fire of our rage.

texts.zh:
我们再次击败了篡位者的爪牙。他们不会停止进犯，且下一次会变得更加凶猛。但是如果我们能摧毁足够多的敌人，或许连他们也会明白，想要抹除我们并非易事。

只要[capital_scope.GetName]仍在飘扬，我们的宣称就依然有效。我们要让他们知道，有些传承绝不会消亡。
texts.en:
We have defeated the agents of the usurper once more. They will not stop coming, and next time they will be stronger. If we break enough of them, perhaps even they will learn that we are not so easily erased.

As long as [capital_scope.GetName] flies, so too does our claim. We will teach them that some legacies refuse to die.

texts.zh:
宏伟的舰队在[solar_system.GetName]严阵以待，傲慢地冠以大汗谕使之名。

然后，一声熟悉的呼唤不加修饰地传来：

“流亡者竟敢回来？难道就没有一点独自在黑暗中消亡、被耻辱地遗忘掉的自知之明吗？那我们就亲手了结你们。”

受选者的武器开始充能，我们其他的掠夺者同胞也严阵以待。在这样的决斗中，没有人会越界，因为结果将决定谁将成为他们的新一任可汗。
texts.en:
The grand fleet lies in wait at [solar_system.GetName], arrogantly bearing the name Chosen of the Great Khan.

Without fanfare, a familiar voice hails us:

"So the Exiled dare to return? No decency to die alone in the dark, forgotten and dishonored? Then we finish you ourselves."

As the Chosen power their weapons, the rest of our Marauder kin hold fast. None will trespass on such a duel, not when the outcome will determine who among them shall lead as Khan."

texts.zh:
指挥舱内的寂静被如潮水般涌入的信息炸裂声打破。集结的各氏族正以沸腾的喧嚣向他们的新冠军致敬并效忠誓言。

我们做到了。王座是我们的了。
texts.en:
The silence over our command bridge shatters as an explosion of messages cascades in. The assembled clans hail their new champion in riotous clamor and oaths of fealty.

We have done it. The throne is ours.

label.en: Let sound the drums of war.

tooltips.zh: 成为大可汗，退出所有联邦和星海共同体。
tooltips.en: Become the Great Khan, leaving any Federation and Galactic Community.

label.zh: 可汗的时代结束了。让我们向你展示流放教会了我们什么。
label.en: The era of Khans is over. Let us show you what exile taught us.

tooltips.zh: 集结的部落会成为我们的附庸。
tooltips.en: The assembled clans become our vassals.

label.zh: 大仇已报，剩下的人可以走了。
label.en: Vengeance has been served. The rest of you may go.

tooltips.en: Leave the Marauders to their own devices.

texts.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会将目光转向这片星河的其他地方。所有舰队聚集起来，载运着无数狂热战士。尽管他们数个月之前还是刀兵相见的敌人，但现在，他们是渴望一同对外战争扩张的同志了。
texts.en:
For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste and accomplished what most thought impossible. Through a combination of guile, charisma and military genius, the newly crowned Great Khan has won the utter loyalty and devotion of all [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] factions.

Now that they are no longer busy killing each other, the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their attention elsewhere. Great fleets are massing for war, crewed by eager warriors who are now steadfast comrades in arms despite having been mortal enemies mere months ago.

texts.zh:
我是[raider_khanate.Ruler.GetName]，是[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗，我在这里向整个星系宣布，我们即将迎来新时代。[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]为了荣耀和资源而彼此争斗的黑暗时代已经结束了。

我向我的人民保证，新建立的伟大帝国将让[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]物种的名字永远刻在星系编年史中。

那些企图阻碍我们的人给我记好了：我将不惜一切代价让我的人民实现自己的抱负，如果你们胆敢反抗我们，[raider_khanate.GetName]必将消灭你们。
texts.en:
I am [raider_khanate.Ruler.GetName], Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and I am here to announce to the galaxy that a new age is upon us. The dark era where [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would senselessly butcher one another for scraps of resources or a misguided sense of honor has finally come to an end.

I have solemnly promised my people a new beginning through the formation of a great empire that will forever enshrine the name of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] species in the annals of galactic history.

To those who would stand in our way, know this: I will stop at nothing to realize the true destiny of my people. If you oppose us, the [raider_khanate.GetName] will grind you into dust.

texts.zh: 大可汗麾下[raider_khanate.GetName]的崛起让很多同我们签订契约的[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]雇佣兵陷入了民族主义的狂潮，这些雇佣兵无视与我们签订的契约，并纷纷倒戈加入了大可汗的阵营。
texts.en: The rise of the [raider_khanate.GetName] under their vaunted Great Khan has triggered mass defections among all of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries that were in our employ! Caught up in a sudden influx of nationalistic fervor, the traitors have all abandoned their contracts and left to join the Great Khan's growing war machine.

texts.zh: 在败给[From.GetName]后，我们必须放弃对汗位的宣称。现在我们只能眼睁睁地看着别人夺取王位。
texts.en: After our defeat at the hands of the [From.GetName] we must forfeit our claim to the Khanate. All we can do now is watch as someone else seizes the throne.

texts.zh:
指挥舱内的寂静被如潮水般涌入的信息炸裂声打破。集结的各氏族正以沸腾的喧嚣向他们的新冠军致敬。

然而，一切尚未结束。还有其他流亡者也拥有王位继承权。根据法律和习俗，他们必须在三年内向我们发起挑战，否则将永远沦为弃民。
texts.en:
The silence over our command bridge shatters as an explosion of messages cascades in. The assembled clans hail their new champion in riotous clamor.

However, it is not over. There are other exiles with a claim to the throne. By law and custom, they must challenge us within three years or remain outcasts forever.

texts.zh:
在前往[marauder_rally_point.GetName]的途中，我们收到了令人沮丧的消息：一名和我们分庭抗礼的宣称者已经先于我们击败了目标。那位准大汗被击败了。现在，[From.GetName]宣称拥有了王座。

按照习俗，我们必须在三年内击败他们的旗舰，否则将丧失统治权。
texts.en:
On our way to [marauder_rally_point.GetName] we received crushing news: a rival claimant has beaten us to our quarry. The would-be Khan is defeated. Now the [From.GetName] claim the throne. 

By custom we must defeat their capital ship within three years, or forfeit our right to rule.

texts.zh:
时机已到。我们那些胆小的对手已经放弃。所有其他潜在的篡位者都已处理完毕。氏族统一的力量正支持着我们。

终于，我们坐上了属于自己的王座。
texts.en:
It is time. Our cowardly rivals have given up. All other would-be usurpers have been dealt with. The unified might of the clans is behind us.

At last, we sit on our rightful throne.

texts.zh:
自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是[capital_scope.GetName]。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。

我们要让他们失望了。
texts.en:
Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the [capital_scope.GetName] in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.

We will have to disappoint them.
